Milkweed
Type: Material
Value: 4
Fine Value: 24
Keywords: Ingredient
Plant
Properties:
Bankable:     Droppable:
Sellable:     Tradable:

A flowering plant known for its milky sap. Butterflies and caterpillars love these!

The Milkweed item is a material.

Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' quality material can replace a normal drop with a base rate of 1/100. This can be increased by using items with the fine material finding attribute.

Variations

Attributes (Input)

This item provides these attributes when used as an input for some activities. Fine materials used also benifit from a global bonus when used as inputs.

Quality Attributes

None

Global +40% Work efficiency
Global +200% Fine material finding
Global +10% Double rewards
Global +100% Bonus experience
